verdict.rationale: Before a run, Marlin narrows the direction of the investigation through a brief exchange with the user, which gives some pre-run control over scope. Once the course is set it works without further human input, and cancelling is the only documented mid-run action, with credits still consumed. Missing for 10: explicit depth or effort controls (e.g. run length, page count, thoroughness level), any mid-run steering or redirection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pre-run scoping exchange.
